description: Registry of production-ready responsive email templates for each hiring stage.

cv_received.subject: Application Received: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
cv_received.preheader: We have received your application for the {{job_title}} position at {{company_name}}.
cv_received.trigger_event: Candidate submits CV via Gmail or job application form.
cv_received.next_step: AI parses and scores candidate CV; HR reviews candidate scorecard.

application_rejected.subject: Update regarding your application for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
application_rejected.preheader: Thank you for your interest in the {{job_title}} position at {{company_name}}.
application_rejected.trigger_event: HR reviews candidate CV scorecard and marks application as rejected.
application_rejected.next_step: Candidate profile archived; candidate eligible for future openings.

application_approved.subject: Congratulations! Next Steps for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
application_approved.preheader: Your application for {{job_title}} has been approved. Please share your availability.
application_approved.trigger_event: HR approves candidate screening; candidate shortlisted for initial interview.
application_approved.next_step: Candidate replies with 2-3 availability time slots for Initial Interview.

interview_confirmed.subject: Confirmed: {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}} - {{date}}
interview_confirmed.preheader: Your {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}} is scheduled for {{date}} at {{time}} {{timezone}}.
interview_confirmed.trigger_event: Recruiter schedules interview round in calendar.
interview_confirmed.next_step: Candidate and interviewer join video meeting at confirmed time.

alternate_slots.subject: Scheduling Your {{round_name}} Interview: Alternate Times for {{job_title}}
alternate_slots.preheader: Please review alternate interview times for your {{round_name}} Interview.
alternate_slots.trigger_event: Candidate proposed slots conflict with interviewer calendar availability.
alternate_slots.next_step: Candidate picks one alternate slot or suggests new times by reply deadline.

next_round_availability.subject: You're Moving Forward! Availability for {{round_name}} Interview - {{company_name}}
next_round_availability.preheader: Congratulations on passing your previous round! Next step: {{round_name}} Interview.
next_round_availability.trigger_event: Candidate passes previous interview round; advance to next round.
next_round_availability.next_step: Candidate replies with availability slots for the next round.

interview_passed.subject: Great news regarding your {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}}
interview_passed.preheader: You have successfully passed the {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}!
interview_passed.trigger_event: Interviewer/HR logs passing scorecard for Initial or Behavioral round.
interview_passed.next_step: Recruiter sends next_round_availability with specific round expectations.

interview_rejected.subject: Update on your interview for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
interview_rejected.preheader: Thank you for taking the time to interview with us for the {{job_title}} position.
interview_rejected.trigger_event: Candidate rejected following any interview round evaluation.
interview_rejected.next_step: Candidate file closed; feedback recorded in pipeline archive.

all_rounds_cleared.subject: Congratulations! You have cleared all interview rounds for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
all_rounds_cleared.preheader: You have successfully completed all interview stages for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}!
all_rounds_cleared.trigger_event: Candidate clears final technical round with positive recommendation.
all_rounds_cleared.next_step: HR prepares offer letter and schedules offer review call.

interview_reminder_24h.subject: Reminder: {{round_name}} Interview Tomorrow - {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
interview_reminder_24h.preheader: Your {{round_name}} Interview is scheduled for tomorrow at {{time}} {{timezone}}.
interview_reminder_24h.trigger_event: 24 hours prior to scheduled interview round.
interview_reminder_24h.next_step: Candidate verifies readiness and attends interview on schedule.

interview_reminder_1h.subject: Starting in 1 Hour: {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}}
interview_reminder_1h.preheader: Your {{round_name}} Interview begins at {{time}} {{timezone}}. Meeting link enclosed.
interview_reminder_1h.trigger_event: 1 hour prior to scheduled interview round.
interview_reminder_1h.next_step: Candidate joins video call room 5 minutes early.

no_response_followup.subject: Following up: Next steps for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
no_response_followup.preheader: Just checking in regarding your interview scheduling for {{job_title}}.
no_response_followup.trigger_event: Candidate has not replied 48 hours after availability request.
no_response_followup.next_step: Candidate replies with time slots before reply deadline.

application_closed_no_response.subject: Application Closed: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
application_closed_no_response.preheader: Notice regarding your application status for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}.
application_closed_no_response.trigger_event: Reply deadline elapsed without response from candidate.
application_closed_no_response.next_step: Application archived; candidate can reapply in the future.

interview_rescheduled.subject: Rescheduled: {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}} - {{date}}
interview_rescheduled.preheader: Your {{round_name}} Interview has been rescheduled to {{date}} at {{time}} {{timezone}}.
interview_rescheduled.trigger_event: Interview rescheduled due to candidate or interviewer calendar adjustment.
interview_rescheduled.next_step: Candidate and interviewer attend interview at updated date and time.

interview_cancelled_by_company.subject: Notice: Cancellation of {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}}
interview_cancelled_by_company.preheader: Important update regarding your scheduled {{round_name}} Interview on {{date}}.
interview_cancelled_by_company.trigger_event: Company cancels interview due to unforeseen internal conflict or emergency.
interview_cancelled_by_company.next_step: Recruiter follows up within 24 hours to re-coordinate interview timing.

candidate_cancelled_confirmation.subject: Confirmation of Interview Cancellation: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
candidate_cancelled_confirmation.preheader: We have processed your interview cancellation for the {{round_name}} round.
candidate_cancelled_confirmation.next_step: Assess whether candidate requests reschedule or formal application withdrawal.

candidate_no_show.subject: We missed you today: {{round_name}} Interview for {{job_title}}
candidate_no_show.preheader: We were unable to connect with you for your {{round_name}} Interview on {{date}}.
candidate_no_show.trigger_event: Candidate does not attend interview call after 15-minute grace period.
candidate_no_show.next_step: Candidate replies within 24 hours to explain absence or reschedule.

cv_unreadable_or_unsupported_format.subject: Action Required: Please resend your resume for {{job_title}}
cv_unreadable_or_unsupported_format.preheader: We were unable to parse your resume attachment for the {{job_title}} position.
cv_unreadable_or_unsupported_format.trigger_event: Automated CV extraction fails due to corrupted or unsupported file format.
cv_unreadable_or_unsupported_format.next_step: Candidate resends resume in valid PDF or DOCX format.

duplicate_application.subject: Notice Regarding Duplicate Application for {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
duplicate_application.preheader: We noticed multiple submissions for the {{job_title}} position.
duplicate_application.trigger_event: Candidate submits duplicate application for the same role.
duplicate_application.next_step: Active candidate profile remains in review pipeline.

application_on_hold.subject: Application Status Update: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
application_on_hold.preheader: Your profile for {{job_title}} has been added to our Talent Pool.
application_on_hold.trigger_event: Role paused, requisition frozen, or candidate tagged for talent pool.
application_on_hold.next_step: Candidate profile preserved in talent pool for future outreach.

documents_request.subject: Document Request: Pre-Offer Verification for {{job_title}}
documents_request.preheader: Please provide required verification documents for your {{job_title}} application.
documents_request.trigger_event: Candidate clears interview pipeline; pre-offer background verification initiated.
documents_request.next_step: Candidate uploads or replies with required compliance documentation.

offer_letter_cover.subject: Offer of Employment: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
offer_letter_cover.preheader: We are thrilled to offer you the position of {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}!
offer_letter_cover.trigger_event: HR manually dispatches official offer letter package.
offer_letter_cover.next_step: Candidate reviews, signs, and returns offer letter before deadline.

offer_accepted_confirmation.subject: Welcome to the Team! Offer Acceptance Confirmed - {{company_name}}
offer_accepted_confirmation.preheader: We have received your signed offer letter for {{job_title}}. Welcome aboard!
offer_accepted_confirmation.trigger_event: Candidate signs and returns offer letter.
offer_accepted_confirmation.next_step: People Ops initiates pre-boarding and IT provisioning workflows.

offer_declined_acknowledgement.subject: Acknowledgement of Offer Decision: {{job_title}} at {{company_name}}
offer_declined_acknowledgement.preheader: Thank you for your consideration regarding the {{job_title}} position.
offer_declined_acknowledgement.next_step: Requisition reopened or next ranked candidate contacted.

welcome_onboarding.subject: Welcome to {{company_name}}! Onboarding Information for {{job_title}}
welcome_onboarding.preheader: Important onboarding instructions and Day 1 details for {{candidate_name}}.
welcome_onboarding.trigger_event: 3-5 days prior to new hire start date.
welcome_onboarding.next_step: Candidate reviews Day 1 schedule and prepares for orientation.

hr_new_cv_scored.subject: [Action Required] New Candidate Scored: {{candidate_name}} for {{job_title}}
hr_new_cv_scored.preheader: New candidate application parsed and scored for {{job_title}}. Ready for review.
hr_new_cv_scored.trigger_event: New candidate CV parsed, contact extracted, and initial screening score computed.
hr_new_cv_scored.next_step: HR reviews candidate profile and scorecard to Approve or Reject.

hr_candidate_replied_availability.subject: [Action Required] Availability Received: {{candidate_name}} for {{round_name}}
hr_candidate_replied_availability.trigger_event: Candidate replies with time slots for interview scheduling.
hr_candidate_replied_availability.next_step: Recruiter selects best time, schedules calendar event, and confirms with candidate.

hr_interview_scheduled.subject: [Scheduled] {{round_name}} Interview: {{candidate_name}} for {{job_title}}
hr_interview_scheduled.trigger_event: Interview calendar invitation generated and sent.
hr_interview_scheduled.next_step: Interviewer prepares evaluation notes and joins session at scheduled time.

hr_interviewer_reminder.subject: [Reminder] Upcoming Interview Today: {{candidate_name}} ({{round_name}})
hr_interviewer_reminder.preheader: Reminder: You have an interview with {{candidate_name}} starting at {{time}} {{timezone}}.
hr_interviewer_reminder.trigger_event: 2 hours prior to scheduled interview round.
hr_interviewer_reminder.next_step: Interviewer conducts interview and fills scorecard.

hr_pending_decision_reminder.subject: [Pending Decision] Action Needed for {{candidate_name}} - {{job_title}}
hr_pending_decision_reminder.preheader: 48 hours have elapsed without a decision logged for {{candidate_name}} ({{round_name}}).
hr_pending_decision_reminder.trigger_event: Candidate remains in pending state 48 hours after interview or scoring.
hr_pending_decision_reminder.next_step: HR or hiring manager reviews scorecard and logs an Approve or Reject decision.

hr_candidate_moved_to_offer_section.subject: [Action Required] Prepare Offer Letter: {{candidate_name}} - {{job_title}}
hr_candidate_moved_to_offer_section.preheader: {{candidate_name}} has passed all interview rounds. Ready for offer generation.
hr_candidate_moved_to_offer_section.trigger_event: Candidate clears final technical round and moves to offer stage.
hr_candidate_moved_to_offer_section.next_step: HR and executive leadership draft compensation terms and generate offer document.
